List playlist images. Use this tool to list playlist images.

Usage:
  yutu playlistImage list [flags]

Examples:
# List images of a playlist
yutu playlistImage list --parent PLxxx
# List playlist images with limit in JSON format
yutu playlistImage list --parent PLxxx --maxResults 10 --output json

Flags:
  -h, --help                                   help for list
  -n, --maxResults int                         The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit (default 5)
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   YouTube channel ID linked to the content owner
  -o, --output string                          json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -P, --parent string                          Return PlaylistImages for this playlist id
  -p, --parts strings                          Comma separated parts (default [id,kind,snippet])
